properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-16, in his words: *"have something that can be verified/checked deterministically (something that rules out that the AI agent just didn't make up a measurement — in general, this is why I created reflow2 was to overcome some of the shortcomings of LLMs)."*

⭐ THIS IS THE FOUNDING FEAR, restated. The 2026-08-30 brainstorm named its two halves — an artifact that is WRONG, and one that QUIETLY DECIDES something nobody chose — and said reflow2 has doctrine for the second (no fabricated repair, no fill-in when rendering) and NOT for the first: "a confident wrong number nobody asked about is still wrong." This idea is about the first half.

═══ WHAT THE GRAPH ALREADY HOLDS, and it is more than it looks ═══
· TemporalFact carries `basis` (measured | forecast) and `confidence` — a fact already says whether it was observed or projected. It does not say WHAT INSTRUMENT observed it or WHAT it was computed from.
· A Verification can name a file as its EXECUTABLE FORM (cap:record-to-record-relations-are-modelled), and loop_status already counts checks with `has_executable_form: false` — the deterministic re-run leg exists and is counted: on reflow2's own design 265 of 270 checks have no executable form, which is the honest measurement of how far from "deterministic" the self-host is.
· Constraint carries quantity / limit / direction and budget_report sums them — quantities are modelled where they are limits; nowhere else.
· dec:calibration-is-an-edge: circular validation is made visible structurally (CALIBRATED_AGAINST), never detected analytically — the same posture this idea would take.
· The accepted unit-system requirement (2026-09) is unallocated and unbuilt — a quantity with no unit is already agreed to be a defect and nothing yet reports one.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ A QUANTITY CARRIES ITS PROVENANCE, LIKE A FACT CARRIES ITS BASIS. Wherever the design stores a number that matters (a constraint's limit, a fact's value, an interface's rate), it also stores how it was obtained: `measured` (by what, when — an Artifact or an instrument), `computed` (from which quantities, by which executable check), or `asserted` (somebody's word, with a name — or nobody's). A detector reports every asserted quantity with no name on it, the way an acknowledgement with no approver is reported today. ⚠️ Cost: another property on three types; and "asserted by the agent" must be an allowed, visible state, not a refusal — the agent will propose numbers, the point is that they read as proposals.
B. DETERMINISM THROUGH THE EXECUTABLE FORM. The rule: a capability counts as VERIFIED only when its check has an executable form and a recorded run; a check the agent merely reports on is `reviewed` evidence, never `verified`. ⚠️ Counter: most real checks in most domains are analyses and inspections with no script — a stamped structural calc, a code review — and demoting them all to unverified makes the delivery line useless. The honest version grades evidence (the evidence-quality instrument already does) rather than refusing it.
C. THE CHECK IS OUTSIDE THE AGENT BY CONSTRUCTION. A quantity is trusted only when its source is an artifact the agent did not author — a measurement file, a tool's output, a person's recorded word. ⚠️ Counter: an agent-authored parametric script that a tool compiles is a legitimate source; the line is "did a tool or a person produce this number", not "did the agent touch it".
D. NOTHING NEW — basis and executable form already exist; use them. ⚠️ Counter: 265 of 270 checks have no executable form and nothing asks for one at capture, so "exists" is not "reaches a project".

═══ THE HONEST LIMIT ═══
No design tool can rule out a made-up number. What it can do is make a number with no source LOOK DIFFERENT from a number with one, count them, and put the count in front of the person at every boundary — which is the same thing reflow2 does for a requirement nobody confirmed, a check nobody ran, and a gap nobody was asked about. The ask is to extend that discipline to quantities.
properties.name: OPEN — how does the design rule out that a number was made up? Every quantity says how it was obtained (measured, computed from what, or asserted by nobody), and every check that matters has a form a tool can re-run
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill, nothing promoted. Recorded as its own idea rather than folded into the unit-system requirement because units answer "is this number comparable" and provenance answers "where did this number come from" — a value can be in the right unit and still be invented. The measurement that anchors it (265 of 270 checks with no executable form) is read from loop_status on the day of writing and will move.
